faq.q: Why does an invalid layer restriction paint nothing instead of the whole car?
faq.a: A present-but-invalid source_layer_mask becomes an all-zero mask in the cached helper. This fails closed instead of silently painting unrestricted artwork. Check/re-establish the layer restriction rather than increasing finish strength; the decoder warning is a transport/coverage issue.

faq.q: Is a missing layer restriction the same as an invalid one?
faq.a: A missing source_layer_mask returns None, meaning this helper supplies no restriction. An invalid present mask is converted to zero coverage by the cached helper. Those are different situations; do not remove a protective restriction merely to make an effect appear.

faq.q: Can half-opacity layer ownership give me a half-strength material finish?
faq.a: The normalized source-layer ownership mask is binary: values at or above 0.5 own the pixel, lower values do not. Ownership is not finish strength. Use the appropriate material/paint strength control for blending and inspect the actual selected artwork.

faq.q: Why can fine layer edges differ between a reduced preview and full size?
faq.a: When layer-mask dimensions differ, this normalizer resizes with INTER_AREA and thresholds the result at 0.5. Tiny structures can fall below area-majority coverage at reduced size. That is not proof of bad finish design or a reason to enlarge all features; compare actual full-size coverage.

faq.q: Why does a one-valued run-length mask not count as fully owned?
faq.a: Run-length transport values are decoded as byte values divided by255, so RLE value1 means1/255, not normalized full ownership. A direct normalized array with value1 means full ownership. The representation matters; malformed or wrong-unit restriction data is a source-owner issue, not a customer finish setting.

faq.q: Does Save Zone Preset capture only the Zone whose editor is open?

faq.q: Why are my drawn regions and spatial masks missing from a named Zone preset?
faq.a: The named-preset snapshot explicitly replaces regionMask and spatialMask with null. Its load path also clears both. This reusable setup differs from the full configuration mask codec; do not rely on it to preserve drawn sponsor footprints.

faq.q: Will later edits to my live Zone change an already captured named preset snapshot?
faq.a: The snapshot is copied through JSON stringify/parse before storage. Subsequent mutations of JSON-compatible nested material or pattern settings do not alter that captured copy. This copy does not preserve every JavaScript type and is not native project-pixel storage.

faq.q: Why are Sprint and sprint separate named Zone presets?
faq.a: Save trims the name, then matches existing entries with exact string equality. Names differing by case therefore remain separate. Leading/trailing spaces are removed for a saved name, so adding those spaces does not create a separate variant.

faq.q: Does the Saved preset toast prove that my named Zone setup reached persistent storage?
faq.a: The localStorage writer catches errors silently. Save calls it and then displays Saved preset without verifying the write. A quota or storage failure can therefore leave the new setup only in that operation’s memory despite the toast. No real profile storage was changed in this audit.

faq.q: Why can my named Zone preset list suddenly be empty?
faq.a: The list loader returns an empty array when reading or parsing stored JSON throws. That fallback does not diagnose whether the issue was storage access or corrupt content, and does not prove the old list was intentionally deleted. Preserve the relevant profile when investigating.

faq.q: If I decline Overwrite Preset, does the old named Zone setup remain?
faq.a: For an exact-name match Save awaits confirmation before replacing the list entry. A declined confirmation returns before the storage write. That path preserves the previously loaded entry; it does not save the newly captured snapshot under another name.

faq.q: Which Zone state is saved if I edit Zones while the overwrite confirmation is open?
faq.a: The snapshot and Zone count are captured before awaiting overwrite confirmation. If you then confirm, that captured state is written, rather than a fresh snapshot of later edits. Finish the intended changes before starting Save and review the timing of an overwrite.

faq.q: Does loading a named Zone preset append its Zones to my current list?
faq.a: After confirmation the load handler pushes a Zone Undo entry, clears the current zones array and fills it from the preset. It replaces the complete list rather than appending. Current Zone array indices can therefore refer to different Zones afterward.

faq.q: Why does a loaded named preset select its first Zone?
faq.a: The load handler sets selectedZoneIndex to0 after rebuilding the list. It does not restore the previously selected row. With an empty snapshot,0 is still assigned even though it is not a valid populated row; a selected index alone is not material or coverage proof.

faq.q: Does deleting a stored Zone preset remove its material from the current car?
faq.a: Delete filters matching entries from the stored preset list after confirmation. It does not replace zones or restore a previous live material setup. Deleting saved reuse data and changing the active paint configuration are different operations.

faq.q: Does a named Zone preset containing sourceLayer IDs also store the PSD layer pixels?
faq.a: The snapshot copies Zone fields, including existing source-layer references, but it does not capture the PSD layer pixel buffers. A retained ID cannot make a missing or different document’s layer exist. Check target bindings in the current source document before reusing that setup.
